note: Tentacle core module specification (2026-11-10, tentacle core A8; design docs/2026-11-10-neumor-design-tentacle-core-v1.md sections 1.3, 1.4, 3.4 and 3.5; architecture by Luis Jake Gabriel III). One specification applied to every tentacle (`applies_to`: all lens names of nmsubs::lens::NAMES) over one copy of the released weights. Each module names its kind, the weight clusters it is provisioned with (NPCS groups of nmnpcs::decompose: `attn`, `head:<set>`, `kv:<set>`, `ffn`, `embed`, `final`; layers by range keyword: `sense` = 0..=L_d, `drone` = the layers of the drone set, `deep` = L_d+1..last, `none`), whether those clusters are shared by reference or held per tentacle, and its state in the first form (`built`, `first form`, `not built`). L_d is derived at run time: the highest layer of the tentacle's drone set (designs/drones.json). Gating modules state their rule, what it is derived from and the stated fallback. Since 2026-11-19 (lane DR; master plan 3.3, Phase 0 audit rules 3.3.1, 3.3.3, 3.3.13): each module may name the `component` of the assembled core it binds to; nmapi::tentacle_core::Core::assemble builds the core's read from these components in the order listed (attention, feed-forward, gating and routing, memory, recurrent paths), not as conventional blocks, and refuses an anatomy that lacks a required kind or step. Read by nmapi::tentacle_core::Spec; validated by `neuromorph-nano check designs`; shown per tentacle by `nano-lab anatomy tentacles`.
window: nmsubs::lens::BUDGET tokens per tentacle (12,000, a firm direction), the whole code base, read whole
parallel: Processor phases (calibration, gates, ranking, reports) run on one thread per tentacle (G1 starts them). Device reads take the device gate one at a time: the card is one device with one stream and 4 GB, and on the processor one read already spreads over every core. Rule recorded in each run's note.

modules.name: T.sense
modules.runs_on: each piece once, alone (the drones' layers 0 to k)

modules.name: T.mem
modules.runs_on: kept piece keys, the pieces' local memory (drone readings), the kept content-free reads

modules.name: T.tip
modules.runs_on: the whole window under the tentacle's pose (periphery read)

modules.name: T.cal
modules.rule: calibrated log-odds per piece: per head the log-mean-exp of raw scores over the piece, mean over the question's content tokens, posed minus content-free at the same positions, summed over heads; the per-head posed and content-free values kept for the no-information ratio

modules.name: T.gate1
modules.rule: report depth by posterior mass: softmax of the calibrated log-odds over the window, the smallest set of pieces holding REPORT_MASS of the mass, then cut to the card tokens the call's allocator grants this tentacle
modules.derived_from: the window's own calibrated log-odds and the tentacle's token grant

fallback.why: served shortlist, G1 rule D2 (runs/2026-11-10-neumor-note-g1-result.md), used when no piece has a finite score

modules.name: T.reread
modules.runs_on: the shortlisted pieces joined, under the pose (self-started integration when the margin lies in the noise band)

modules.name: T.gate2
modules.rule: deep check when the top-two margin is below the shortlist's median absolute deviation or the top's calibrated log-odds is at most 0; the top two pieces when the margin lies in the noise band, else the top one

fallback.why: spans checked per tentacle at most (design section 3.4 item 5)

modules.name: T.deep
modules.runs_on: the pieces the deep gate names, read whole with the question
modules.where: nmapi::tentacle_core::deep_check (nmapi::joint_read::pass_with with the yes and no tails)

modules.name: T.out
modules.runs_on: the last prompt position of each yes-or-no tail
modules.where: two label rows of the tied embedding (yes, no), read by nmapi::joint_read::pass_with; calibrated by three content-free forms (nmapi::tentacle_core::NULL_FORMS)

modules.name: T.decide
modules.runs_on: the window's log-odds, the read and the deep check
modules.rule: the core's local decisions: report depth by posterior mass; no information when the posed-to-null ratio of the best piece is at most 1 over its heads (mean posed minus content-free at most 0) and the deep check, when run, is at most 0; next look: a definition on top pulls its companion, an anomalous reported piece is flagged; G2 can override each
modules.derived_from: the window's own scores and the pieces' drone readings

fallback.why: REPORT_MASS: share of the posterior mass the reported pieces hold when no grant cuts them

modules.name: T.route
modules.where: nmapi::tentacle_core: the report sends spans by reference to its g0_tx; wants by reference to G1

modules.name: T.core
modules.runs_on: readings of the tip and the re-read
modules.rule: reported score = a piece's calibrated log-odds; confidence = its posterior share in the window; spread = median absolute deviation of the shortlist's log-odds; margin = the first over the second in spreads

modules.name: T.report
modules.runs_on: one report per question or instruction
report_fields: best spans by reference with calibrated log-odds and confidence
modules.where: nmapi::tentacle_core::CoreReport::to_g0, held by each core's g0 (g0_t1 to g0_t8)

modules.name: T.recur
modules.runs_on: the core's state across rounds: pieces already read, the last report's best, its margin and reads
modules.where: nmapi::tentacle_core::Carried, carried through the tentacle's g0 from round to round
